# Family ITR Workspace

Privacy-first browser workspace for coordinating Indian individual income-tax returns for AY 2026-27.

- [Application](/): Browser-local organizer and evidence workflow.
- Privacy and operating boundary: Tax records stay in the browser unless a user explicitly enables a direct BYO API request.

The application does not submit or e-verify returns. Users must validate final figures and eligibility with the official Income Tax Department utility.
